SELECT , IFNULL(agg.give_amount, 0) AS give_amount, IFNULL(agg.receive_amount, 0) AS receive_amount, IFNULL(agg.give_amount, 0) + IFNULL(agg.receive_amount, 0) AS total_amount, IFNULL(participants.participant_count, 0) AS participant_count, IF(e.remark IS NOT NULL AND e.remark != '', e.remark, '-') AS location_text, CASE WHEN e.event_time IS NOT NULL AND e.event_time > NOW() THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'FINISHED' END AS event_status FROM gift_event_info_t e LEFT JOIN gift_person_info_t p ON p.id = e.host_person_id AND p.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.event_id, SUM(CASE WHEN r.direction IN ('GIVE', 'RETURN') THEN IFNULL(r.amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS give_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.direction = 'RECEIVE' THEN IFNULL(r.amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS receive_amount FROM gift_record_info_t r WHERE r.event_id IS NOT NULL AND r.is_delete = 0 GROUP BY r.event_id ) agg ON agg.event_id = e.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pr.event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.person_id) AS participant_count FROM ( SELECT r.event_id, r.giver_person_id AS person_id FROM gift_record_info_t r WHERE r.event_id IS NOT NULL AND r.giver_person_id IS NOT NULL AND r.is_delete = 0 UNION ALL SELECT r.event_id, r.receiver_person_id AS person_id FROM gift_record_info_t r WHERE r.event_id IS NOT NULL AND r.receiver_person_id IS NOT NULL AND r.is_delete = 0 ) pr GROUP BY pr.event_id ) participants ON participants.event_id = e.id
ORDER BY e.event_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT e.event_type FROM gift_event_info_t e WHERE e.org_id = #{orgId} AND e.is_delete = 0 AND e.event_type IS NOT NULL AND e.event_type != '' AND e.event_type NOT IN ( SELECT o.event_code FROM gift_event_type_option_t o WHERE o.user_id = 0 AND o.option_type = 'SYSTEM' AND o.is_delete = 0 AND o.event_code IS NOT NULL )
